children: JonDeTech Sensors AB (publ) ("JonDeTech" or the "Company") invites shareholders, warrant holders and the general public to an investor meeting on Monday, October 26 at 4:00 p.m. at the Company's office in Stockholm.
The investor meeting will be held at the Company’s office at Drottning Kristinas väg 45 in Stockholm on Monday, October 26 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.
The Company’s CEO, Jonas Wærn, will present the Q3 report, provide a general update on the business and answer questions. The team will also demonstrate the Company’s products.
To attend JonDeTech’s investor meeting, please register by sending an email to ir@jondetech.com no later than Friday, October 23 2026.

JonDeTech is a Swedish high-tech company developing digital and analogue heat sensors for measuring Core Body Temperature (CBT). The Company’s patented sensor technology combines a very small form factor with high accuracy and low power consumption, enabling integration into high-volume products such as wearables, medical sensors and other consumer products. The technology is designed to enable continuous body temperature monitoring in mass-produced consumer products, representing the next major technological step in digital health and wearables as body temperature data becomes as established as heart rate monitoring. JonDeTech operates through a global network of distributors and partners, with the objective of supplying sensors to leading global players in consumer electronics and digital health.
JonDeTech’s share is listed on NGM Growth Market.
